title: Wrecks and salvage
summary: Old wrecks lie out in the world. A Field Engineer next to one strips it for alloys.
text:
Here and there lie the broken hulls of landers that came down long ago. Once one has been seen (Scout Skimmers are good at finding them), it's a store of alloys waiting to be taken.

Park a **Field Engineer** (from the Vehicle Bay) beside a wreck. With nothing to repair, it strips the hull and the alloys come straight in until the wreck is empty.

- Wrecks are usually out past your defences: send a few guns with the engineer
- Research in the Precursor branch makes engineers strip them faster

Take a close look at them while you're there. They are built a lot like you.
